text: The UEBA system flagged this week for AFB3228 (Adele Fiona Boone) due to unusual volume of logons outside her working hours and browsing to job-search sites atypical for her role. Specifically, she logged on four times outside her typical range, which is unusual given the evidence provided. Additionally, she visited job-search sites 70 times, which is significantly higher than her recent typical usage (36) and even exceeds the average for same-role peers (8).
